Compensation and severance terms remain open for negotiation, as do the scope and enforceability of any restrictive covenants. The draft remains subject to client and partner review.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the “Company”) and [Executive’s full legal name] (the “Executive”).

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of [TO BE AGREED], payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, and shall be eligible to participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans, subject to their terms.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive severance in an amount and on payment terms to be agreed. The definition of Cause and any conditions to severance remain subject to negotiation.

4. NON-COMPETE. [The parties will discuss whether a post-employment non-competition restriction is appropriate and permissible under applicable law. Any restriction, including its duration, geographic reach and scope of restricted activities, remains subject to agreement.]

receiver.message_back: Our proposal is $450,000 base salary, a 50% target bonus, no post-employment noncompete, and, upon termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, 24 months’ base salary plus two years’ target bonus ($1.35 million total), payable in a lump sum subject to applicable tax requirements, together with 24 months’ Company-paid health coverage or an equivalent taxable subsidy if coverage cannot lawfully continue. Cause should be limited to fraud, embezzlement, conviction of a felony involving dishonesty, or willful material misconduct causing material Company harm, with written particulars and 30 days to cure where curable; Good Reason should include a material reduction in compensation, duties or authority, relocation exceeding 50 miles, or material Company breach, subject to Executive notice within 90 days, a 30-day Company cure period and resignation within 60 days thereafter, with any release mutually agreed and no mitigation or offset.
